components.name: Pain
components.title: Assessment, prevention and management of pain
components.significant: CPOT greater than 2, BPS greater than 5, or NRS greater than 3

components.name: Breathing trials
components.title: Spontaneous awakening and spontaneous breathing trials
components.significant: SBT safety screen requires SpO2 at or above 88 percent, FiO2 under 50 percent and PEEP under 7.5 cmH2O

components.name: Delirium
components.title: Delirium assessment, prevention and management
components.significant: CAM-ICU positive, negative or unable to assess

components.name: Early mobility
components.title: Early mobility and exercise
components.significant: SCCM defines no numeric adherence threshold for this component

components.name: Family engagement
components.title: Family engagement and empowerment
components.significant: SCCM defines no numeric adherence threshold for this component
